mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lifecycle_outbox(message_id, event_type, tenant_id, object_type, object_id, occurred_at, topic, message_key, payload_json) SELECT #{messageId}, #{eventType}, #{tenantId}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{occurredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, #{payload} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lifecycle_outbox WHERE message_id = #{messageId})

INSERT INTO lifecycle_outbox(message_id, event_type, tenant_id, object_type, object_id, occurred_at, topic, message_key, payload_json) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{eventType}, #{tenantId}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{occurredAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{topic}, #{messageKey}, #{payload}) ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, event_type, tenant_id, object_type, object_id, occurred_at, topic, message_key, payload_json, attempts FROM lifecycle_outbox WHERE (status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status = 'in_flight' AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY available_at, created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
